fields.finding: The Gaussian-imperfection paths have an earlier local maximum and descending branch before their largest traced pressure. Reconstructed-indentation paths differ.
fields.consequence: A largest-pressure comparison alone does not identify the first instability. Sampled turning points are retained; no dynamic jump or nonaxisymmetric stability is proved.

claim: The Gaussian-imperfection paths have an earlier local maximum and descending branch before their largest traced pressure. Reconstructed-indentation paths differ.
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
